next_step: Demo dedicated VPC infra + HSM integration checklist; legal to review DPA
notes:
Customer: Telehealth provider handling PHI and payment info; heavy compliance requirements (HIPAA + PCI). Primary ask: agent assist + ticket summarization in a private VPC with full audit trail and retention controls.

Highlights / ask:
- No public inference endpoints allowed; locked down VPC peering and private link only.
- Must support SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning for 500+ agents.
- Tamper-evident audit logs for every model call; retention policy up to 7 years for transcripts.
- HSM-backed keys or customer-managed KMS; cannot use shared keys.
- Redaction rules: automatic PAN/SSN masking at ingest; ability to wipe transcripts on request.
- Spike handling: support bursts (simulated up to 5x baseline for 1 hour); deterministic fallbacks to smaller quantized model when capacity constrained.

Quotes from call: "We will not accept any PII sent to an unmanaged public endpoint." — VP Ops.

Integration notes:
- Tool-calling: must wire into ServiceNow ticket updates and internal agent desktop via secure webhook.
- Want function-calling for runbook lookups and automated triage (confidence threshold + human-in-loop).
- Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions: batching + quantization recommendations for cost help.

Commercial / Process:
- 6-week technical POC requested (security review + load test).
- Legal needs a section in the DPA for PHI/PCI; procurement timeline likely Q2 2026.

CRM shorthand / internal:
- high risk but strategic (telehealth vertical).
- AE: Aisha; SE: Marco; need CISO sign-off after infra demo.

sla_targets: p95 < 180ms for agent_assist; sustained throughput 3k rps; burst 5x for up to 1 hour; 99.9% availability target for dedicated capacity
data_retention_policy: retain PHI transcripts for 7 years; redact PCI PANs at ingest; allow subject-access export & on-demand redaction; immutable audit log retention for 7 years
use_case_summary: Primary: live agent assist (context-aware suggestions, canned replies), automatic ticket summarization for long multi-email threads, tool-calling into ServiceNow and internal runbooks, and reranking of KB search results. Focus on deterministic behavior during spikes and reproducible audit trails for compliance.
notes_short: Evaling private VPC + HSM; legal/DPA is main blocker; POC showed promising fallback behavior under spike but needs HSM integration; next demo to CISO scheduled.
